name: Ligus 0.1.0
notes: Ligus 0.1.0, the first release. Ligus is short for ligustica. The CLI is ligus, settings are LIGUS_*, config is ligus.config.toml and workspace state lives in .ligus/. Features: repos from the phone with fork-aware pull requests opened upstream as drafts; whole-file proposal view so the phone renders Markdown changes; Kubernetes deployment design and a container image for the ligus binary.
